The residence offers five en-suite bedrooms with the option of a sixth bedroom, home office or studio, dual master suites, a media room and a gallery hall. Floor-to-ceiling openings connect the open-plan living, kitchen and dining areas to the pool, a sunken lounge and a BBQ deck. A private rooftop lounge with jacuzzi completes the home.

Buyers can choose from three interior concepts: Minimal Modern, Mediterranean Luxe or Bohemian Artist.

Smart-home features, gated security, concierge and management
Ownership stated as HGB; confirm title with your notary

listings.title: Designer 3 BR Villa with Dual Pools, Private Sauna & Ocean View Rooftop in Pererenan
listings.summary: Discover an exclusive collection of just seven contemporary villas positioned approximately 150-200 metres from the ocean in prestigious Pererenan.
listings.description:
Designed for refined tropical living, Lot 5 offers 274 m² of thoughtfully planned space with panoramic glazing, 3.2-metre ceilings and high-quality finishes throughout. The villa is delivered fully furnished and equipped, combining modern architecture with warm, design-led interiors.

One of its defining features is the inclusion of two private swimming pools: a spacious ground-floor pool surrounded by tropical landscaping and a rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views. The exclusive rooftop also features a private sauna and generous lounge space-ideal for sunset cocktails, BBQ dinners or relaxing above the Pererenan coastline.

The villa offers three bedrooms and two bathrooms, with a layout designed to balance privacy, comfort and effortless indoor-outdoor living.

Located in one of Bali's most desirable coastal neighbourhoods, the property offers privacy while remaining within easy reach of Pererenan's restaurants, cafés, wellness venues, coworking spaces and beach clubs. La Brisa, Le Bajo, and several padel and tennis facilities are also nearby.
highlights: Rooftop infinity pool with panoramic views
Private rooftop sauna and lounge area
Approximately three minutes' walk to the beach
